entities.summary: Juan Claudio González Calderón is a former Chilean footballer, that played as centre back. Before joining Iquique, González had successful seasons with Audax Italiano and Universidad de Chile. At Audax was the most successful in the football career of González, during the 2007 season. The defender obtained important achievements in his career thanks to his coach in this time Raúl Toro, who has also trained to González in Coquimbo Unido, which meant a share of trust very important.
